---
title: v2.2.6 — Unified Rust Workspace Version and Installer State
---

## Overview

This release records one Rust workspace version across Work and Tooling, simplifies the installer state and release package metadata, and shares typed runtime host metadata between both CLIs.

## Highlights

- Replace separate Work and Tooling version fields with `rust_workspace_version` in installer state and release package metadata.
- Rename the installer state directory field to `global_instructions_dir` and validate the current state format on macOS and Windows.
- Share typed host environment metadata between Work command execution records and Tooling CLI results, using `execution.host.rust_workspace_version` in both outputs.
- Define Tooling CLI response status and envelope contracts in `tooling-model`, and validate serialized CLI results against that model.
